summary: Phase 8 testing complete. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass covering workflow template CRUD (admin only, tenant scoped, audit), per-tenant email integration (masked key, preserve-on-blank, test send), Google session 400/401 paths, and email/password login. Frontend: Google login button present and source-verified to redirect to auth.emergentagent.com; Settings Integrations tab persists Resend config with masked key hint on reload; Workflow template create dialog creates a 3-step template that appears in the Workflow Builder with edit/delete actions and version-bumping PATCH on resave; mobile sidebar drawer + overlay + close work. Two issues found: (1) mobile horizontal-scroll overflow ~39px at 414px viewport (page content exceeds clientWidth), (2) dnd-kit keyboard drag activator in the Template Editor did not actually reorder steps (UI saved with same order). Mouse-drag and the underlying PATCH steps-array endpoint both work.

ui_bugs.issue: Keyboard drag activator on tpl-step-handle-* does not actually swap steps (Space->ArrowDown*2->Space leaves steps in original order, version still bumps because save fires). Mouse-based drag was not exercised by automation; verify the keyboard activator config or document that only mouse drag is supported.

issues: Body has ~39px horizontal scroll (scrollWidth=453 vs clientWidth=414). Header row (tenant pill, language switch, notifications, user avatar pill) overflows the viewport; user-avatar pill is clipped off-screen on the right. The PageHeader/topbar needs min-w-0/flex-wrap or to hide some elements behind the mobile menu on <480px viewports.

action_items: Fix mobile topbar horizontal overflow at <=480px: shrink/collapse tenant selector or user-pill into a menu, or add flex-wrap/min-w-0 on the header flex container so total width stays <= 100vw.
Either enable @dnd-kit KeyboardSensor with sortableKeyboardCoordinates so screen-reader users can reorder steps, or document that only mouse drag is supported (a11y improvement).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py crossed 700 lines (~956) – consider splitting auth/session, integrations, institutions into separate routers (currently only routes_workflows.py is extracted).
GET /api/integrations/{id} returns api_key:null + api_key_masked suffix – good. PATCH preserves existing key when blank – good and explicitly tested.
POST /api/auth/session correctly returns 400 (missing sid) and 401 (bogus sid), never 500 – good error mapping via httpx try/except + raise_for_status().
Workflow template _validate_steps enforces kind enum, duplicate keys and non-empty steps via 422 – good Pydantic-style validation.

Focus retest on (a) mobile header overflow fix (verify at 414x800 scrollWidth==clientWidth) and (b) dnd-kit keyboard reorder if a11y is requested. rca of the issue.mobile_horizontal_scroll: Likely cause: the top header (Shell.jsx topbar) renders Tenant selector, search, language, notifications and user-pill in a single flex row without min-w-0/flex-wrap or responsive hiding rules. Total intrinsic width > 414px. Fix: at sm:hidden viewports, hide search and/or compress user-pill to avatar-only; ensure header container is flex flex-wrap or has overflow-x-auto. Verify by measuring document.documentElement.scrollWidth at 414px after fix – should be <=414.
rca of the issue.dnd_keyboard_reorder: Likely cause: TemplateEditor.jsx uses @dnd-kit useSortable but the DndContext may only register PointerSensor (mouse/touch), not KeyboardSensor. Without KeyboardSensor + sortableKeyboardCoordinates, pressing Space on the handle does not initiate a sortable pick-up. Confirm by checking sensors=[useSensor(PointerSensor), useSensor(KeyboardSensor, {coordinateGetter: sortableKeyboardCoordinates})].
